notes.title: The Short Track Asphalt Pack is now available!
notes.content:
The SRX season may be over, but things are still heating up with SRX: The Game! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1669680/SRX_The_Game__Short_Track_Asphalt_Pack/]The Short Track Asphalt Pack[/url] is now available as FREE DLC!

Try out the new Super Late Model series on 6 all-new asphalt tracks! Wish the SRX series was longer? Now you can run a longer SRX schedule with a variety of other tracks, including the new tracks included in this pack!

This content is available in all modes of play, including Career and Online Multiplayer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40606351/397b96fb57608630b40c20a3d94d5cd6e38e82a1.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch notes (July 20, 2021)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Add support for new DLC
[*] Update SRX car paint schemes
[*] Update SRX rules for starting order in Main Race
[*] Add an option to repair SRX cars between races
[*] Add more sponsor decals to car editor
[*] Add Luke Fenhaus and Scott Bloomquist as playable cars in the SRX series
[*] SRX "ringers" race in correct events
[*] Other minor improvements and fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes (June 9, 2021)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare crash that could occur in career and championship.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes (June 8, 2021)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Update with Camping World SRX Series branding
[*] Added additional SRX paint schemes
[*] Added additional sponsors to car creator
[*] Added option to car creator to "Reset to Default"
[*] Prevent 3-digit car numbers from wrapping
[*] SRX cars can race at more tracks
[*] Added more season schedule options
[*] Improved transmission sounds
[*] Address "backwards-wall-riding" exploit
[*] Reset all leaderboards
[*] On post-race summary screen in career, display correct money earned
[*] Adjusted tuning of Career Exhibition season
[*] Other tuning adjustments
[*] Fix lap count displayed in replay of SRX races
[*] In multiplayer leaderboards, don't show invalid track/series combinations
[*] Other minor improvements and fixes
[/list]
